ambient: The bars settle a fraction and are exactly where they were.
Somewhere a machine confirms that everything is nominal.
description: A landscape made entirely of colour bars, held very steady, with a tone laid across it at a level somebody set once and never went back to. It is here so that you can confirm the equipment is working. The equipment is working. There is nothing else scheduled.
name: The Test Card

looks: Eight of them, in the correct order, going down to black at the edge of everything.
They have been steady so long that the steadiness is the only thing happening.
One of them is fractionally wrong and you cannot find it twice.
objects.name: the bars

looks: A single note held by something that does not need to breathe.
It is at the reference level. Everything here is at the reference level.
You stop hearing it, and then you hear it again, and it has not changed at all.
objects.name: the tone

weather: Conditions are nominal. They have been set to nominal and left.
